title: Pointwise assembly of constant-target mapping-space pullback squares
statement:
Use quasicategories, small simplicial sets, coherent functor categories, coherent transformations, constant diagrams $\Delta_K$ and right-pinched mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the path-space homotopy pullback squares of [def-coef-infinity-relative-cone]. Let $r:\mathcal X\to\mathcal Y$ be a functor of quasicategories, let $B$ and $K$ be small simplicial sets, either of which may be empty, let $a:B\to\mathcal X$ and $f:B\times K\to\mathcal X$ be coherent diagrams, let $\alpha:f\to a\circ\mathrm{pr}_B$ be a coherent transformation of diagrams $B\times K\to\mathcal X$, and let $w$ be a vertex of $\mathcal X$. For a vertex $b$ of $B$ write $f_b=f|_{\{b\}\times K}$ and $\alpha_b:f_b\to\Delta_K a(b)$ for the restricted cocone. Suppose that for every vertex $b$ of $B$ the square
$$\begin{array}{ccc}\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal X}(a(b),w)&\longrightarrow&\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal X)}(f_b,\Delta_Kw)\\ \downarrow&&\downarrow\\ \operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal Y}(ra(b),rw)&\longrightarrow&\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal Y)}(rf_b,\Delta_K rw)\end{array}$$
whose horizontal maps are composition with $\alpha_b$ and $r\alpha_b$ and whose vertical maps are induced by $r$, with its canonical commutation homotopy, is a homotopy pullback. Then the square
$$\begin{array}{ccc}\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(B,\mathcal X)}(a,\Delta_Bw)&\longrightarrow&\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(B\times K,\mathcal X)}(f,\Delta_{B\times K}w)\\ \downarrow&&\downarrow\\ \operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(B,\mathcal Y)}(ra,\Delta_Brw)&\longrightarrow&\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(B\times K,\mathcal Y)}(rf,\Delta_{B\times K}rw)\end{array}$$
whose horizontal maps are composition with $\alpha$ and $r\alpha$ (after applying $\mathrm{pr}_B^*$) and whose vertical maps are induced by $r$, is a homotopy pullback. If $B$ is empty all four corners are contractible; if $K$ is empty the right-hand corners are contractible and the hypothesis and conclusion say that $r$ induces equivalences on the left-hand columns. No colimit existence in $\mathcal X$ or $\mathcal Y$ and no fibration condition on $r$ is assumed.

source.place: Proposition 5.1.2.2 (limits and colimits in functor categories are detected pointwise) and Corollary 5.1.2.3, applied in the mapping-space form: the mapping space into a constant diagram is the limit over $B^{\mathrm{op}}$ of the pointwise mapping spaces, and limits of spaces preserve homotopy pullback squares. Same assembly as Kerodon Proposition 7.1.8.10 (02XK) used in lem-coef-infinity-relative-cocone-parameters, here with the test object fixed. Read online; archive WANTED. No Stacks tag states this quasicategorical assertion.
